newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Paliburg plans convertible bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Paliburg plans convertible bond issue.

text.p: Paliburg Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it proposed an issue of guaranteed convertible bonds due 2002 convertible into shares of the company.
The company said it has agreed with Jardine Fleming International Inc to launch the convertible bonds to be issued by Paliburg's wholly-owned Paliburg Finance (C.B. 2002) Ltd.
The bonds, which will be listed in Luxembourg, are intended to be offered to professional investors, the statement said.
Net proceeds of the bond issue are intended to be used for general working capital and for development of the company's property and related business in Hong Kong, Paliburg said.

The company said it would make a further statement regarding the final terms and structure, including the aggregate principal amount of the issue, the rate of interest payable and the number of shares into which the bonds will be convertible.
Shares in Paliburg fell HK$0.05 to HK$9.30 per share at midday.
